svg.title: A change of coordinates between two domains
svg.desc: A disk and a convex feasible region connected by a map. Matching radial grids and copper points show how the same coordinates correspond in both domains.
svg.metadata: Analytic radial homeomorphism Φ(ru) = r R(u)u, with Φ(0) = 0. Reference disk is the Euclidean unit ball. Target is (x/1.18)^4 + (y/.90)^4 ≤ 1. Copper points share r = .67 and angle −33 degrees.
